stem:
A student investigates an electrical circuit. A power supply of electromotive force (e.m.f.) *E*ₛ and negligible internal resistance is connected in series to three resistors, each of resistance *Z*.

A cell, an ammeter and a resistor of resistance *R* are connected in parallel across one of these resistors, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The current *I* is measured by the ammeter for different values of *R*.

It is suggested that *I* and *R* are related by the equation

3*E* − *E*ₛ = *I*(3*R* + 2*Z)

where *E* is the e.m.f. of the cell.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A graph is plotted of 1/*I* on the y-axis against *R* on the x-axis.

Determine expressions for the gradient and y-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *R* and *I* are given in Table 2.1.

[[fig:f2]]

Calculate and record values of 1/*I* / A⁻¹ in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in 1/*I*.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Plot a graph of 1/*I* / A⁻¹ against *R* / kΩ. Include error bars for 1/*I*.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Label both lines.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the y-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine the values of *E* and *Z*. Include appropriate units.

Data: *E*ₛ = (2.20 ± 0.05) V

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated. Determine the resistance *R* that gives a value of *I* of 250 µA.

figures.caption: Fig. 2.1
figures.alt: Circuit diagram showing a power supply and three series resistors, with a cell, ammeter and resistor connected in parallel across one of the resistors.

figures.caption: Table 2.1

A blank graph grid with 1/I in A⁻¹ on the vertical axis and R in kΩ on the horizontal axis.
